name: Backlash

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: When you take damage, your Reaction lashes back: the damage is reduced by 4d6 + your spellcasting modifier, and if the creature that hurt you is within 60 feet it makes a Constitution save, taking 4d6 Force damage (half on a success). Both rolls gain 1d6 per slot level above 4. Against an attack you're asked; against spells and hazards it's used only when set to Automatic in the class tab.
